title: 2140 Prairie's back wing gets its windows
items: 1904: the Tucker/Smith house's three-storey back wing at 2140 Prairie now has windows on all three of its yard sides, with cellar windows under them. Its kitchen door and steps moved to stand between the back windows. The 1911 fire map's gravel roof and two fire escapes are noted on the house's card but not built, because nothing shows them there by 1904.
